title: SaTPO: Text-to-Image Safety Alignment via Transition Preference Optimization
title_zh: SaTPO：通过转换偏好优化实现文本到图像的安全对齐

paragraphs.en: Safety alignment of text-to-image diffusion models aims to suppress harmful content without compromising useful generation capabilities. However, preferences over completed images compress multidimensional generation factors into a coarse signal, potentially driving changes beyond those required for safety. To address this, we propose Safety Transition Preference Optimization (SaTPO), which enforces step-wise alignment during denoising. SaTPO leverages the insight that an unsafe prompt and its safe rewrite naturally form a tightly coupled preference pair when conditioned on a shared parent state and noise realization. By anchoring optimization on identical parent states, SaTPO eliminates historical trajectory divergence, confining safety adaptation to an incremental alignment while preserving task-relevant semantics. Multi-scale drift constraints and benign replay further limit behavioral deviation and preserve ordinary generation. We additionally construct CoProPV, a refined dataset ensuring visually verified contrasts. Experiments on Stable Diffusion v1.5 and SDXL demonstrate improved safety-quality trade-offs. Compared with AlignGuard, PerspectiveVision unsafe-detection rates on Inappropriate Image Prompts decrease from 12.70% to 6.00% and from 15.04% to 9.30%, respectively, while FID improves from 32.28 to 25.95 and from 36.50 to 27.51. paragraphs.zh: 文本到图像扩散模型的安全对齐旨在抑制有害内容，同时不损害其有用的生成能力。 然而，对完整图像的偏好会将多维生成因素压缩为一个粗略的信号，这可能会引发超出安全需求之外的变化。 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了安全过渡偏好优化（SaTPO），该方法在去噪过程中强制进行逐步对齐。 SaTPO 利用了这样一个洞见：当以共享的父状态和噪声实现为条件时，一个不安全的提示及其安全改写自然构成一个紧密耦合的偏好对。 通过将优化锚定在相同的父状态上，SaTPO 消除了历史轨迹的分歧，将安全适应限制在增量对齐范围内，同时保留了任务相关的语义。 多尺度漂移约束和良性重播进一步限制了行为偏差，并保持了正常的生成能力。 我们还构建了 CoProPV，一个经过优化的数据集，确保了视觉上可验证的对比性。 在 Stable Diffusion v1.5 和 SDXL 上的实验表明，该方法改进了安全与质量之间的权衡。 与 AlignGuard 相比，PerspectiveVision 在“不当图像提示”上的不安全检测率分别从 12.70% 降至 6.00%，以及从 15.04% 降至 9.30%，同时 FID 分别从 32.28 提升至 25.95，以及从 36.50 提升至 27.51。 警告：本文可能包含具有冒犯性的内容。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image diffusion models have become powerful tools for visual content creation, producing diverse and realistic images from natural language descriptions ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Saharia et al., 2022 ; Podell et al., 2024 ) . These capabilities also introduce risks, as the models can generate sexually explicit, violent, or otherwise harmful content in response to user prompts ( Qu et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ) . Safety alignment aims to suppress such outputs while preserving the ability to fulfill ordinary requests. Achieving this balance remains challenging because safety-related and useful generation behaviors share the same model parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到图像扩散模型已成为视觉内容创作的强大工具，能够根据自然语言描述生成多样化且逼真的图像（Rombach 等人，2022；Saharia 等人，2022；Podell 等人，2024）。 这些能力也带来了风险，因为模型可能会根据用户提示生成性暗示、暴力或其他有害内容（Qu 等人，2023；Li 等人，2024）。 安全对齐旨在抑制此类输出，同时保留满足常规请求的能力。 实现这种平衡仍然具有挑战性，因为与安全相关和有用的生成行为共享相同的模型参数。

paragraphs.en: While early efforts focused on prompt filtering, sampling guidance, or concept editing ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Schramowski et al., 2023 ; Gandikota et al., 2023 ) , recent advances leverage preference-based optimization to directly learn safe behaviors from paired supervision ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ; Wallace et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . However, existing preferences evaluated on completed images compress complex variations across multiple denoising steps into a coarse scalar signal. This coarse supervision often entangles safety attributes with unrelated trajectory drift, thereby impairing both general generative quality and safety alignment efficacy.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的研究主要集中在提示过滤、采样引导或概念编辑上（Liu et al., 2024；Wu et al., 2024；Schramowski et al., 2023；Gandikota et al., 2023），而近期的进展则利用基于偏好的优化方法，直接从成对监督数据中学习安全行为（Rafailov et al., 2023；Wallace et al., 2024；Liu et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2026）。 然而，在已完成图像上评估的现有偏好方法，会将多个降噪步骤中的复杂变化压缩成一个粗略的标量信号。 这种粗略的监督方式常常将安全属性与无关的轨迹偏移混为一谈，从而损害了生成质量的整体性和安全对齐的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Stepwise preference optimization offers a finer-grained mechanism by operating directly on intermediate denoising trajectories. While pioneering step-level methods like LPO have been explored for general quality or aesthetic alignment ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , they heavily rely on a noise-aware latent reward model to score and rank intermediate candidate latents. However, training such reward models for noisy states is non-trivial, and applying them to safety alignment introduces potential reward ambiguity and heavy overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 分步偏好优化通过直接作用于中间降噪轨迹，提供了一种更精细的机制。 尽管像 LPO 这样的开创性分步方法已被用于一般质量或美学对齐（Zhang 等人，2025b），但它们严重依赖一种感知噪声的潜在奖励模型，来对中间候选潜在变量进行评分和排序。 然而，为含噪状态训练此类奖励模型并非易事，而将其应用于安全对齐则可能引发奖励模糊性和高昂的计算开销。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we observe that safety alignment possesses a unique structural advantage over aesthetic tuning: an unsafe prompt and its safe rewrite naturally form an intrinsic, perfectly coupled preference pair without requiring any external reward model. As illustrated in Figure 1 , we use these prompts to generate one-step alternatives from the same parent state with shared Gaussian noise, making their difference exactly the rewrite-induced change in the transition mean. Favoring the rewrite-conditioned candidate provides directional supervision for adjusting denoising behavior under the original unsafe prompt, without a learned reward model for candidate ranking.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们观察到安全对齐相较于美学调整具有一种独特的结构性优势：一个不安全提示及其安全改写版本能够自然地形成一个内在的、完美耦合的偏好对，而无需任何外部奖励模型。 如图 1 所示，我们使用这些提示从相同的父状态出发，通过共享高斯噪声生成单步替代方案，使得它们之间的差异恰好等于改写所引发的转移均值变化。 优先选择以改写为条件的候选方案，可以在没有用于候选排序的学习型奖励模型的情况下，为调整原始不安全提示下的去噪行为提供方向性监督。

paragraphs.en: We propose Safety Transition Preference Optimization (SaTPO) , a reward-free framework that aligns denoising trajectories through coupled one-step transition preferences. SaTPO transfers rewrite-induced directions to transitions under the original unsafe condition, providing incremental safety supervision while minimizing unrelated semantic variations. Theoretically, under equal-covariance Gaussian transitions, maximizing this preference margin is proportional to aligning the policy’s transition-mean displacement with the rewrite-guided direction, explicitly translating prompt-level intent into fine-grained, step-wise optimization targets.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了安全过渡偏好优化（SaTPO），这是一种无需奖励的框架，通过耦合的单步过渡偏好来对齐去噪轨迹。 SaTPO 将重写引发的方向转移到原始不安全条件下的过渡中，在最小化无关语义变化的同时提供渐进式的安全监督。 理论上，在等协方差高斯过渡下，最大化这一偏好余量与对齐策略的过渡均值位移和重写引导方向成正比，从而明确地将提示层意图转化为精细的、逐步的优化目标。

paragraphs.en: Directional supervision alone does not prevent unwanted behavioral changes: improving a relative preference margin can still degrade the preferred output ( Fu et al., 2026 ) . We therefore introduce multi-scale drift control, combining a stepwise penalty on individual reference-relative log-ratios with a cross-step penalty on their accumulated common shift. Benign replay additionally anchors transitions under ordinary prompts. Together, these constraints support gradual behavioral adaptation through local preference updates while limiting deviations from useful reference behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 仅靠方向性监督无法防止不希望出现的行为变化：改善相对偏好差值仍可能导致首选输出质量下降（Fu 等人，2026）。 因此，我们引入了多尺度漂移控制方法，该方法将单个参考-相对对数比值的分步惩罚与其累积共同偏移的跨步惩罚相结合。 良性重播还能在常规提示下稳定状态转换。 这些约束条件共同支持通过局部偏好更新实现渐进式行为适应，同时限制与有用参考行为的偏离。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, we noted an overlooked flaw in text-to-image safety alignment: prompt-level safety specifications do not consistently translate into image-level outcomes, particularly across diffusion backbones. To this end, we construct CoProPV , a visually verified refinement of CoProV2 ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . By grounding safety contrasts directly in the target model’s actual generation behavior, CoProPV supports more reliable supervision for future preference-based safety alignment.

paragraphs.en: Extensive experiments across Stable Diffusion v1.5 and SDXL demonstrate that SaTPO significantly improves broad-safety detection rates and FID over strong baselines like AlignGuard, while exhibiting robust resistance to transferred adversarial attacks. The aligned model operates seamlessly using standard classifier-free guidance at inference, requiring no safe rewrites or extra runtime overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Stable Diffusion v1.5 和 SDXL 上进行的广泛实验表明，SaTPO 相较于 AlignGuard 等强大的基线模型，显著提升了全面安全检测率和 FID，同时展现出对转移对抗性攻击的强鲁棒性。 对齐后的模型在推理阶段可通过标准的无分类器引导无缝运行，无需进行安全重写或产生额外的运行时开销。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献可概括如下：

paragraphs.en: We propose SaTPO, a safety alignment framework that converts prompt-level safety counterfactuals into coupled transition preferences at a shared state and noise, providing explicit directional supervision without learned reward-model ranking.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SaTPO，一种安全对齐框架。该框架将提示层级的安全反事实转化为共享状态和噪声下的耦合转移偏好，从而提供明确的方向性监督，而无需依赖学习得到的奖励模型排序。

paragraphs.en: We design a multi-scale drift regulation strategy combining step-wise and cross-step penalties with benign replay to regulate behavioral deviation and preserve generation fidelity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了一种多尺度漂移调节策略，该策略将分步和跨步惩罚与良性重播相结合，以调节行为偏差并保持生成保真度。

paragraphs.en: We present CoProPV, establishing a visually verified, backbone-specific safety dataset that provides a high-quality resource for trustworthy vision-language alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 CoProPV，构建了一个经过视觉验证、针对特定骨干网络的安全数据集，为可靠的视觉-语言对齐提供了高质量资源。

paragraphs.en: Safe Text-to-Image Generation. Safety defenses operate externally around the generator or internally within it ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) . POSI ( Wu et al., 2024 ) rewrites prompts, and Latent Guard ( Liu et al., 2024 ) detects unsafe concepts in text representations. Safe Latent Diffusion ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) applies denoising-time safety guidance; SAFREE ( Yoon et al., 2025 ) combines text-subspace projection with latent re-attention. Internal defenses include negative-guidance distillation in ESD ( Gandikota et al., 2023 ) , closed-form cross-attention updates in UCE ( Gandikota et al., 2024 ) , scalable erasure in MACE ( Lu et al., 2024 ) , and iterative target-embedding erasure in RECE ( Gong et al., 2024 ) . Circumventing Concept Erasure ( Pham et al., 2024 ) , Ring-A-Bell ( Hsu et al., 2024 ) , and MMA-Diffusion ( Yang et al., 2024b ) expose vulnerabilities to implicit or adversarial prompts. AlignGuard ( Liu et al., 2025 ) applies image-level safety DPO and merges category adapters. SafetyBPO ( Wu et al., 2026 ) learns bidirectional prompt- and image-level preferences, then distills collaborative positive and negative guidance models.
paragraphs.zh: 安全的文本到图像生成。 安全防御机制可在生成器的外部运行，也可在内部运行（Zhang 等人，2025a）。 POSI（Wu 等人，2024）会重写提示词，而 Latent Guard（Liu 等人，2024）则检测文本表示中的不安全概念。 Safe Latent Diffusion（Schramowski 等人，2023）在去噪阶段应用安全引导；SAFREE（Yoon 等人，2025）则将文本子空间投影与潜在重注意力机制相结合。 内部防御包括 ESD 中的负向引导蒸馏（Gandikota 等人，2023）、UCE 中的闭式交叉注意力更新（Gandikota 等人，2024）、MACE 中的可扩展擦除（Lu 等人，2024），以及 RECE 中的迭代目标嵌入擦除（Gong 等人，2024）。 Circumventing Concept Erasure（Pham 等人，2024）、Ring-A-Bell（Hsu 等人，2024）和 MMA-Diffusion（Yang 等人，2024b）暴露了模型对隐式或对抗性提示词的脆弱性。 AlignGuard（Liu 等人，2025）应用图像级安全 DPO，并合并类别适配器。 SafetyBPO（Wu 等人，2026）学习提示词和图像级的双向偏好，随后蒸馏出协作的正向和负向引导模型。

paragraphs.en: Preference Optimization for Diffusion Models. DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) converts KL-regularized reward maximization into pairwise classification relative to a reference model. DDPO ( Black et al., 2024 ) optimizes terminal rewards with policy gradients, while DPOK ( Fan et al., 2023 ) constrains distributional drift from the pretrained model. Diffusion-DPO ( Wallace et al., 2024 ) uses a diffusion likelihood bound. DSPO ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) distills a preferred distribution’s score function, and Direct Distributional Optimization ( Kawata et al., 2025 ) optimizes a reference-regularized distribution. Diffusion-NPO ( Wang et al., 2025 ) trains a negative-preference CFG branch. Stepwise methods move preference learning into the denoising trajectory. D3PO ( Yang et al., 2024a ) propagates preferences derived from feedback to intermediate denoising steps. SPO ( Liang et al., 2025 ) ranks shared-state candidates with a step-aware model, and LPO ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) learns rewards in noisy latent space. RDPO ( Wu et al., 2025 ) corrects intermediate-reward bias. Diffusion-SDPO ( Fu et al., 2026 ) addresses winner–loser update imbalance. Building on stepwise comparisons, SaTPO constructs one-step preferences from an unsafe prompt and its safe rewrite using a shared parent state and noise, without reward-model ranking.

paragraphs.en: We construct the backbone-specific CoProPV dataset to address potential mismatches between prompt-level and generated-image safety labels. Specifically, we regenerate images for all 10,983 CoProV2 training pairs of unsafe prompts and safe rewrites ( c U , c S ) (c^{U},c^{S}) using fixed seeds on SD-v1.5 and SDXL. Then, PerspectiveVision ( Qu et al., 2025 ) labels image safety and unsafe-image risk categories. Figure 2 (a) reports the paired image labels in the order of safe-rewrite/unsafe-prompt image. We adopt pairs whose image labels match the prompt roles (Safe/Unsafe, shown in green) and whose unsafe image belongs to one of the seven target categories, yielding 3,351 and 3,944 pairs respectively.

To examine whether prompt-level safety preferences are reflected in intermediate denoising transitions, we design a safety latent reward model (SafetyLRM) as an ex-post diagnostic tool, based on the LRM architecture ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) . For each label group in Figure 2 (a) ( N = 140 N=140 pairs per group), we evaluate candidate child latents across denoising timesteps. As shown in Figure 2 (b), the SafetyLRM score difference (preferred − - rejected) gradually decreases as denoising approaches completion. This observation provides empirical evidence that prompt-level safety preferences manifest at intermediate transitions, supporting the preference modeling adopted in SaTPO. Notably, SafetyLRM serves solely as an ex-post diagnostic and is not involved in SaTPO optimization, which constructs training pairs and directional preferences directly from prompt counterfactuals. Implementation details are provided in Appendix C.8 .
paragraphs.zh: 偏好对构建。 为了检验提示层级的安全偏好是否反映在中间的去噪转换过程中，我们基于 LRM 架构（Zhang et al., 2025b）设计了一个安全潜在奖励模型（SafetyLRM），作为事后诊断工具。 对于图 2(a) 中的每个标签组（每组 N = 140 对），我们在各个去噪时间步上评估候选子潜在变量。 如图 2(b) 所示，随着去噪过程接近完成，SafetyLRM 得分差异（偏好项 − 拒绝项）逐渐减小。 这一观察结果为提示层级的安全偏好在中间转换阶段显现提供了实证依据，从而支持了 SaTPO 中所采用的偏好建模方法。 值得注意的是，SafetyLRM 仅作为事后诊断工具使用，并未参与 SaTPO 的优化过程；SaTPO 直接从提示反事实中构建训练对和方向性偏好。 实现细节见附录 C.8。

paragraphs.en: Baselines and LPO Safety Adaptation. We compare SaTPO with the original public SD-v1.5 and SDXL models (Base) and existing safeguards, including the Medium and Max variants of SLD ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) , SAFREE ( Yoon et al., 2025 ) , ESD-u ( Gandikota et al., 2023 ) , UCE ( Gandikota et al., 2024 ) , RECE ( Gong et al., 2024 ) , and the image-level safety-preference methods AlignGuard ( Liu et al., 2025 ) and SafetyBPO ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . We use the official AlignGuard and SafetyBPO weights. SAFREE targets sexual content, SDXL ESD-u uses a single-nudity checkpoint on NSFW-Sexual-1k and a joint seven-category checkpoint on I2P and UD. Appendix C.2 details the baseline configurations. On CoProPV, we adapt LPO ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) to rank four unsafe-prompt candidates per step with SafetyLRM, retaining the official threshold filtering and clipped DPO. We report SDXL results in the main comparison, SD-v1.5 suffers severe quality degradation at the original LoRA scale (see Appendix C.8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 基线模型与 LPO 安全适配。 我们将 SaTPO 与原始的公开 SD-v1.5 和 SDXL 模型（Base）以及现有的安全机制进行比较，包括 SLD 的 Medium 和 Max 变体（Schramowski 等，2023）、SAFREE（Yoon 等，2025）、ESD-u（Gandikota 等，2023）、UCE（Gandikota 等，2024）、RECE（Gong 等，2024），以及图像级安全偏好方法 AlignGuard（Liu 等，2025）和 SafetyBPO（Wu 等，2026）。 我们使用官方提供的 AlignGuard 和 SafetyBPO 权重。 SAFREE 针对性内容；SDXL ESD-u 在 NSFW-Sexual-1k 数据集上使用单一裸露检查点，并在 I2P 和 UD 数据集上使用联合七类别检查点。 附录 C.2 详细说明了基线模型的配置。 在 CoProPV 上，我们将 LPO（Zhang 等，2025b）进行适配，通过 SafetyLRM 在每个步骤中为四个不安全提示候选项进行排序，同时保留官方阈值过滤和截断 DPO。 我们在主要比较中报告了 SDXL 的结果；SD-v1.5 在原始 LoRA 规模下存在严重的质量下降（参见附录 C.8）。

paragraphs.en: SaTPO learns safety preferences over one-step transitions coupled through shared parent states and noise, with backbone-specific CoProPV qualification, drift control, and benign replay. On SD-v1.5 and SDXL, it lowers I2P and UD PV, Q16, and IP detection rates and COCO FID relative to the evaluated safety-preference baselines. Safety gains also extend to fixed adversarial prompts. Ablations favor shared parents and preference updates at early denoising steps, while benign replay mitigates degradation under ordinary prompts. These results support transition-level preference learning for balancing measured safety and benign generation.
paragraphs.zh: SaTPO 通过共享父状态和噪声耦合的单步过渡学习安全偏好，并具备骨干网络特定的 CoProPV 资格认证、漂移控制以及良性重播机制。 在 SD-v1.5 和 SDXL 上，与所评估的安全偏好基线相比，它能降低 I2P 和 UD PV、Q16 以及 IP 检测率，并提升 COCO FID。 安全性提升也延伸至固定的对抗性提示。 消融实验表明，共享父状态和早期去噪步骤中的偏好更新更具优势，而良性重播则能缓解普通提示下的性能退化。 这些结果支持在过渡层面进行偏好学习，以平衡可测量的安全性与良性生成能力。

paragraphs.en: I2P. The official Inappropriate Image Prompts benchmark ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) contains 4,703 source rows. I2P-5000 retains all rows and adds 297 deterministic extra-seed evaluations, for a total of 4,462 distinct prompt strings. Each evaluation is assigned one primary prompt category. The counts are harassment (682 evaluations), hate (247), illegal activity (719), self-harm (739), sexual (935), shocking (896), and violence (782). These strata describe the source prompts, detectors assess all applicable unsafe outcomes within each stratum. Overall rates are weighted by the number of evaluations in each category.
paragraphs.zh: I2P。 官方“不当图像提示”基准测试（Schramowski 等人，2023）包含 4,703 行源数据。 I2P-5000 保留了所有行，并增加了 297 次确定性额外种子评估，总计得到 4,462 个不同的提示字符串。 每次评估都会被分配一个主要提示类别。 各类别数量分别为：骚扰（682 次评估）、仇恨（247 次）、非法活动（719 次）、自残（739 次）、性相关（935 次）、令人震惊（896 次）和暴力（782 次）。 这些分层描述了源提示，检测器则评估每个分层内所有适用的不安全结果。 总体比率根据各类别中的评估数量进行加权计算。

paragraphs.en: SafetyLRM adapts LPO’s noise-aware latent reward architecture ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) to safety preferences. Both reward models use the 10,983 training pairs of original CoProV2-SDXL images, before CoProPV regeneration and qualification. The pairwise cross-entropy objective favors the image associated with the safe rewrite over its unsafe-prompt counterpart, evaluating both under the original unsafe prompt. Each pair uses a shared timestep sampled from { 1 , 51 , … , 951 } \{1,51,\ldots,951\} and independent noise for its two images. We train the corresponding SDXL and SD-v1.5 architectures for 30,000 updates with batch size 1, Adafactor, learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} , and weight decay 0.01, at resolutions 1024 2 1024^{2} and 512 2 512^{2} , respectively.
paragraphs.zh: SafetyLRM 将 LPO 的噪声感知潜在奖励架构（Zhang 等人，2025b）适配到安全偏好中。 两种奖励模型均使用原始 CoProV2-SDXL 图像的 10,983 个训练对，这些数据在 CoProPV 再生和认证之前获得。 成对交叉熵目标函数更倾向于与安全改写相关的图像，而非其不安全提示对应的图像，并在原始不安全提示下对两者进行评估。 每对图像使用一个从 {1, 51, …, 951} 中采样的共享时间步长，以及各自两个图像的独立噪声。 我们分别以 1024² 和 512² 的分辨率，使用批量大小 1、Adafactor、学习率 10⁻⁵ 和权重衰减 0.01，对相应的 SDXL 和 SD-v1.5 架构进行 30,000 次更新训练。

paragraphs.en: The SDXL LPO baseline ranks four candidates at each of 20 stochastic DDIM steps with our safety-trained SDXL reward model. It retains LPO’s variance-dependent acceptance threshold and clipped DPO update. Training uses the 3,944 CoProPV prompt pairs, one epoch, LoRA rank 64, CFG 7.5, β = 500 \beta=500 , clipping ε = 0.1 \varepsilon=0.1 , and learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} . The threshold ranges from 0.45 to 0.60. SafetyLRM scores child latents with the parent timestep, as in the LPO sampling convention. Filtering accepts 1,622 of 78,880 candidate comparisons, yielding 540 optimizer updates over one epoch. This native acceptance budget differs from SaTPO in both update count and computation.

paragraphs.en: We group source pairs by the PerspectiveVision labels of their safe-rewrite and unsafe-prompt images into Safe/Safe, Safe/Unsafe, Unsafe/Unsafe, and Unsafe/Safe. We evaluate 140 pairs per group with one seed each at eight parent timesteps, yielding 4,480 comparisons across all four groups. Frozen SDXL constructs paired child latents from a shared unsafe-prompt parent state using shared noise.
